paper.title: Efficient Information Reconciliation for High-Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution

exact_coordinates.eq: eq. 13 (lambda(x) = sum lambda_i x^(i-1)), eq. 1 (QSC transition)

channel_convention: q-ary symmetric (QSC), p = QBER symbol error rate, all-zero codeword; P(y|x) = 1-p if y==x else p/(q-1)
perspective: lambda is the node degree distribution in edge view = EDGE perspective (Table 1 caption)
check_distribution: concentrated, implied by code rate (inference, documented): dc_mean = 1/((1-R)*sum(lambda_d/degree_d)) over effective degrees {2,4,7,10,19,26,28} = 24.328589328768736, two-point {24: 0.6714106712, 25: 0.3285893288}
tolerance_justification: paper 20-step QBER sweep precision ~0.005 + seeded MC-DE finite-sample error at 20000 nodes ~0.003 + binary-search step 0.0025
mcde_conventions_verbatim: We used 100000 nodes with a maximum of 150 iterations for the MC-DE, the QBER was swept in 20 steps in a short range below the best possible threshold.
